messages:
sam (sre): Heads up - us-west-3 warm-pool joins started failing right after I applied the tighter egress rule. Keystore decrypts timing out and audit-forwarder QPS spiking. Anyone seeing the same?

maria (infra): Seeing it in logs, thanks for the ping. snippet: `keystore-proxy ERROR decrypt failed: upstream timeout` and audit-exporter showing a burst.

alex (network): FYI natgw conntrack is climbing fast in us-west-3. I suspect audit export -> s3 proxy fanout -> NATGW conntrack exhaustion which then breaks keystore sessions.

june (ops): Controller also shows a bunch of `node join: decrypt failed (504)` from warmpool onboarding. Reproduced on 3 nodes.

ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-proxy-usw3 p95-req: 28s, 5xx-rate: 12% - triggered at 2025-03-12T17:00:05Z

sam (sre): I rolled back the fw tighten on the warm-pool subnets (reopened egress to keystore-proxy and audit-exporter). Can you confirm if joins recover?

maria (infra): After rollback we see fewer keystore errors. A few nodes still in backoff but progressing.

alex (network): Short-term mitigation: increase conntrack on natgw and add conntrack-protect rules for keystore traffic. Longer-term: move audit shipping off NAT (privatelink or VPC endpoint).

june (ops): Also recommend rate-limiting the audit exporter while we stabilize. We can enable sampler = 0.15 to cut peak QPS. Example flag: `--audit-sample-rate=0.15`

security-helm: @sam we can't keep broad egress wide forever for compliance. Need a plan: allow minimal keystore egress and reduce audit fanout. Can we do scoped allowlist for only warmpool instances?

sam (sre): Agreed. Plan: 1) rollback now (done). 2) throttle audit exporter sampler 0.15 (maria to roll). 3) add NAT conntrack bump and a targeted allowlist for warmpool (alex to implement). 4) schedule maintenance to move audit shipper to privatelink (security-helm + infra).

maria (infra): I'll push the sampler toggle to canary config: `kustomize patch: auditExporter: {sampleRate: 0.15}` and watch.

alex (network): Terraform snippet for conntrack bump (placeholder):
``
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "gw" {
  # existing
  enable_flow_logs = true
  # bump conntrack via aws cli + userdata for proxy instances
}
``

june (ops): Filed INC-4521 for the outage, added timelines and rollback notes. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4521

sam (sre): Also adding a short eval: see if keystore-proxy 5xx is due to dial/backpressure vs cert rotation. Logs show upstream 504 -> backpressure.

maria (infra): Monitoring looks green 10m after rollback but onboarding rate is ~0.6x normal. Will continue to watch for 30m.

security-helm: For the compliance ticket: prefer staged changes with rate-limits enabled by default. We'll review the warmpool allowlist approach in the RFC.

sam (sre): Action items: maria toggles sampler canary; alex patches natgw conntrack + scoped allowlist; security-helm to co-author RFC for privatelink audit shipper; june to keep INC updated. I'll close when warm-pool back to baseline.

maria (infra): Started rollout of sampler canary to 3 nodes.

alex (network): Working on Terraform PR for allowlist and conntrack vars.

june (ops): Noted in INC-4521 that rollback prevented large-scale onboards.

sam (sre): Thanks all - keeping thread open until stable. Will post final status in 30m. :thumbsup:
